The honest assessment

Beautiful care begins with knowing what to preserve.

Not every sign of wear needs the same response. Before recommending a service, a Revivé specialist would consider the fibre, cap construction, hairline, density, previous heat or colour work, and how you want to wear the piece next.

Often refreshable

Product buildup, lost curl definition, mild tangling, frizz, and a shape that no longer feels current.

Needs closer inspection

Weak lace, heavy shedding, severe matting, heat-damaged synthetic fibre, or fragile previous repairs.

Our principle

Recommend only what the wig can reasonably support.
